```html
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:#e7ebf0;color:#17212f}
body{font-family:"맑은 고딕",sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;line-height:1.5}
#phone{width:390px;max-width:100vw;height:844px;position:relative;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.screen{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;padding:18px;background:#fff;color:#17212f}
.screen.on{display:block}
h1{font-size:27px;line-height:1.35;margin:12px 0 16px;color:#17212f}

button,input{font:inherit;color:#17212f}
button{min-height:56px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid #788698;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9c4a00;outline-offset:3px}
button:disabled{background:#e5e9ef;color:#475365;cursor:default}
input{width:100%;min-height:58px;border:2px solid #64758a;border-radius:10px;padding:10px;font-size:24px;background:#fff}
input::placeholder{color:#596579;opacity:1}
.nav{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px}

.card p{margin:6px 0}
.large{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#17212f}
.primary{display:block;width:100%;min-height:60px;background:#174fba;border-color:#174fba;color:#fff;font-size:21px;font-weight:700;margin:18px 0 8px}
.wide{width:100%;margin:6px 0}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}

.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:14px 0}
.pad button{font-size:26px;min-height:56px;background:#f3f6fa;color:#17212f}
.quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;margin:14px 0}
.quick button{font-size:17px;background:#eef4ff;color:#173e7a}
.error{font-size:18px;color:#a22319;background:#fff2ee;border-left:4px solid #a22319;padding:10px;margin:8px 0}
.error:empty{display:none}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:14px 0}
.tabs button{flex:1}

.banklist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin:12px 0}
.banklist button{min-height:60px;text-align:left;font-size:20px;white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;color:#17212f}
.banklist button[aria-pressed="true"]{border:3px solid #174fba;background:#eef4ff;color:#143e80;font-weight:700}
.bankfooter{border-top:2px solid #bdc9d8;margin-top:16px;padding-top:8px;color:#17212f}
.summary{margin:16px 0;padding:16px;border:1px solid #b9c8dc;border-radius:12px;background:#f5f8fc;color:#17212f}

.success{padding:10px 0;font-size:44px;color:#174fba}

[hidden]{display:none!important}

  <p id="acc-help" class="help">하이픈(-) 없이 숫자만 입력해 주세요.<br>최대 14자리까지 입력할 수 있습니다.</p>
  <p id="acc-error" class="error" role="alert"></p>

  <p><strong>출금 가능 금액 1,000,000원</strong></p>
  <p id="amt-error" class="error" role="alert"></p>

    <button data-action="previous">이전</button>

  <p id="processing" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <h2 id="ask-title"></h2>
  <p id="ask-description"></p>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const phone = $('phone');
  const ANSWER_ACCOUNT = '110234567890';
  const ANSWER_BANK = '신한';
  const RECIPIENT_NAME = '김철수';
  const BALANCE = 1000000;
  const ACC_MAX = 14;
  const P = window.PRESERVED;
  const BANKS = P.BANKS;
  const SECS = P.SECS;
  const AMT_KEYS = P.AMT_KEYS;
  const ACC_KEYS = P.ACC_KEYS;
  const PW_KEYS = P.PW_KEYS;
  const QUICK = P.QUICK;
  let current = 'start', pending = '', pendingBank = '', tab = 'bank';
  let completed = false, busy = false, transaction = null, timer = null;
  let lastFocus = null;
  const S = {account:'',bank:'',amount:0,pw:''};
  window.__log = [];
  window.__screen = () => current;
  window.__dump = () => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(window.__log));
  const fmt = n => Number(n).toLocaleString('ko-KR');
  function record(type, more){
    window.__log.push(Object.assign({type:type}, more || {}));
  }
  function show(name){
    current = name;
    document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s => {
      s.classList.toggle('on', s.dataset.screen === name);
      if(s.dataset.screen === name) s.scrollTop = 0;
    });
    record('screen_enter',{to:name});
    const heading = document.querySelector('.screen.on h1');
    if(heading) heading.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  function text(id, value){ $(id).textContent = value; }
  function accError(message){
    text('acc-error',message);
    $('acc-fix').hidden = !message;
    $('acc-input').setAttribute('aria-invalid',message ? 'true' : 'false');
  }
  function bankError(message){
    text('bank-error',message);
    $('bank-fix').hidden = !message;
  }
  function renderAccount(){
    $('acc-input').value = S.account;
    text('picked-bank',S.bank || '은행·증권사 선택');
  }
  function korean(n){
    if(!n) return '영';
    const digits = ['', '일','이','삼','사','오','육','칠','팔','구'];
    const units = ['', '십','백','천'];
    function block(v){
      return String(v).split('').map((d,i,a)=>{
        const k = a.length-i-1;
        return d === '0' ? '' : ((d === '1' && k > 0) ? '' : digits[Number(d)]) + units[k];
      }).join('');
    }
    return (n >= 10000 ? block(Math.floor(n/10000))+'만 ' : '') +
      (n%10000 ? block(n%10000) : '');
  }
  function renderAmount(){
    $('amt-input').value = S.amount ? fmt(S.amount) : '';
    text('amt-reading',S.amount ? korean(S.amount).trim()+' 원' : '금액을 입력해 주세요.');
  }
  function setAmount(value){
    if(!Number.isFinite(value) || value > BALANCE){
      text('amt-error','출금 가능 금액을 넘습니다. 더 적은 금액을 입력해 주세요.');
      renderAmount();
      return;
    }
    S.amount = Math.max(0,Math.floor(value));
    text('amt-error','');
    renderAmount();
  }
  function renderRecipient(prefix, data){
    text(prefix+'-name',RECIPIENT_NAME);
    text(prefix+'-bank',data.bank);
    text(prefix+'-account',data.account);
  }
  function renderReview(){
    renderRecipient('rv',S);
    text('rv-amount',fmt(S.amount)+'원');
  }
  function renderPw(){
    text('pw-dots','●'.repeat(S.pw.length)+'○'.repeat(4-S.pw.length));
    text('pw-count','4자리 중 '+S.pw.length+'자리 입력');
  }
  function reset(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    busy = false; completed = false; transaction = null;
    Object.assign(S,{account:'',bank:'',amount:0,pw:''});
    pendingBank = '';
    accError(''); bankError('');
    text('amt-error',''); text('pw-error',''); text('processing','');
    $('transfer').disabled = false;
    renderAccount(); renderAmount(); renderPw();
    $('acc-input').setSelectionRange(0,0);
  }
  window.__startTask = function(){
    if($('ask').open) $('ask').close();
    reset();
    window.__log.length = 0;
    record('task_start');
    show('start');
  };
  function keys(id, list, action){
    list.forEach(v=>{
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.dataset.action = action;
      b.dataset.v = String(v);
      b.textContent = String(v);
      $(id).appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  keys('acc-pad',ACC_KEYS,'acc-num');
  keys('amt-pad',AMT_KEYS,'num');
  keys('pwpad',PW_KEYS,'pw');
  QUICK.forEach(v=>{
    const b = document.createElement('button');
    b.dataset.action = 'quick';
    b.dataset.v = String(v);
    b.textContent = v === 'all' ? '출금 가능 금액 전체' : korean(Number(v)).trim()+' 원 더하기';
    $('amt-quick').appendChild(b);
  });
  function institutions(id,list){
    list.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'ko')).forEach(name=>{
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.dataset.action = 'pick-bank';
      b.dataset.bank = name;
      b.textContent = name;
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
      $(id).appendChild(b);
    });
  }
  institutions('grid-bank',BANKS);
  institutions('grid-sec',SECS);
  function filterBanks(){
    const query = $('bank-search').value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
    let count = 0;
    ['bank','sec'].forEach(group=>{
      const container = $('grid-'+group);
      container.hidden = query ? false : group !== tab;
      container.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>{
        b.hidden = !b.dataset.bank.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
        if(!container.hidden && !b.hidden) count++;
        const selected = b.dataset.bank === pendingBank;
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected));
        b.textContent = b.dataset.bank + (selected ? ' · 선택됨' : '');
      });
    });
    $('tab-bank').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(tab === 'bank'));
    $('tab-sec').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(tab === 'sec'));
    text('search-status',query ? '전체 은행·증권사 검색 결과 '+count+'개' : '선택 가능한 기관 '+count+'개');
    text('bank-choice',pendingBank ? '선택한 기관: '+pendingBank : '아직 선택하지 않았습니다.');
  }
  function openBank(){
    pendingBank = S.bank;
    tab = SECS.includes(S.bank) ? 'sec' : 'bank';
    $('bank-search').value = '';
    text('bank-choice-error','');
    filterBanks();
    show('bank-select');
  }
  function validate(){
    accError(''); bankError('');
    const accountMessage = !S.account
      ? '계좌번호를 입력해 주세요.'
      : S.account !== ANSWER_ACCOUNT
        ? '계좌번호가 맞지 않습니다. 받는 사람에게 받은 번호를 확인하고 다시 입력해 주세요'
        : '';
    if(accountMessage){
      if(current !== 'recipient-details') show('recipient-details');
      accError(accountMessage);
      if(!S.bank) bankError('받는 은행 또는 증권사를 선택해 주세요.');
      $('acc-input').focus();
      record('validation_error',{field:'account'});
      return false;
    }
    if(!S.bank || S.bank !== ANSWER_BANK){
      if(current !== 'recipient-details') show('recipient-details');
      bankError(!S.bank ? '받는 은행 또는 증권사를 선택해 주세요.' :
        '선택한 은행이 받는 계좌의 은행과 다릅니다. 받는 사람의 은행을 확인해 다시 선택해 주세요. 계좌번호는 그대로 두어도 됩니다');
      $('picked-bank').focus();
      record('validation_error',{field:'bank'});
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  }
  function normalizeAccount(raw, caret){
    const clean = raw.replace(/[-\s]/g,'');
    if(!/^\d*$/.test(clean)){
      accError('계좌번호에는 숫자만 입력해 주세요.');
      renderAccount();
      return;
    }
    if(clean.length > ACC_MAX){
      accError('계좌번호는 최대 14자리까지 입력할 수 있습니다. 번호를 확인해 주세요.');
      renderAccount();
      return;
    }
    S.account = clean;
    accError('');
    renderAccount();
    const pos = raw.slice(0,caret).replace(/[-\s]/g,'').length;
    $('acc-input').setSelectionRange(pos,pos);
  }
  function editAccount(value, remove){
    const input = $('acc-input');
    let start = input.selectionStart == null ? S.account.length : input.selectionStart;
    let end = input.selectionEnd == null ? start : input.selectionEnd;
    if(remove && start === end && start > 0) start--;
    const next = S.account.slice(0,start) + value + S.account.slice(end);
    normalizeAccount(next,start+value.length);
  }
  $('acc-input').addEventListener('input',function(){
    normalizeAccount(this.value,this.selectionStart || 0);
  });
  $('amt-input').addEventListener('input',function(){
    const value = this.value.replace(/[,\s]/g,'');
    if(!/^\d*$/.test(value)){
      text('amt-error','금액에는 숫자만 입력해 주세요.');
      renderAmount();
      return;
    }
    setAmount(Number(value));
  });
  $('bank-search').addEventListener('input',filterBanks);
  function ask(kind){
    pending = kind;
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    text('ask-title',kind === 'cancel' ? '이체를 취소할까요?' : '계좌번호를 모두 지울까요?');
    text('ask-description',kind === 'cancel' ?
      '입력한 계좌번호, 은행, 금액이 모두 지워집니다.' :
      '계좌번호만 지웁니다. 은행과 금액은 그대로 남습니다.');
    text('ask-yes',kind === 'cancel' ? '입력 지우고 이체 취소' : '계좌번호 전체 지우기');
    $('ask').showModal();
  }
  $('ask').addEventListener('close',function(){
    if(lastFocus && document.contains(lastFocus)) lastFocus.focus();
  });
  phone.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    const el = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
    if(!el || !phone.contains(el) || el.disabled) return;
    const a = el.dataset.action;
    if(busy) return;

    if(a==='go-recipient'){
      if(completed) reset();
      renderAccount(); show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='previous'){
      const back = {
        'recipient-details':'start','bank-select':'recipient-details',
        'amount':'recipient-details','review':'amount','identity':'review'
      };
      if(current === 'identity'){ S.pw=''; renderPw(); }
      if(back[current]) show(back[current]);
    } else if(a==='cancel'){
      ask('cancel');
    } else if(a==='ask-no'){
      $('ask').close();
    } else if(a==='ask-yes'){
      const kind = pending;
      $('ask').close();
      if(kind === 'cancel'){ reset(); show('start'); }
      else {
        S.account=''; accError(''); renderAccount();
        $('acc-input').focus(); $('acc-input').setSelectionRange(0,0);
      }
    } else if(a==='account-field'){
      $('acc-input').focus();
    } else if(a==='amount-field'){
      $('amt-input').focus();
    } else if(a==='search-field'){
      $('bank-search').focus();
    } else if(a==='fix-account'){
      $('acc-input').focus();
    } else if(a==='acc-num'){
      editAccount(el.dataset.v,false);
    } else if(a==='acc-del'){
      editAccount('',true);
    } else if(a==='acc-clear'){
      ask('clear');
    } else if(a==='open-bank'){
      openBank();
    } else if(a==='tab-bank'){
      tab='bank'; $('bank-search').value=''; filterBanks();
    } else if(a==='tab-sec'){
      tab='sec'; $('bank-search').value=''; filterBanks();
    } else if(a==='pick-bank'){
      pendingBank=el.dataset.bank;
      text('bank-choice-error','');
      filterBanks();
      $('bank-apply').scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'});
    } else if(a==='apply-bank'){
      if(!pendingBank){
        text('bank-choice-error','목록에서 은행 또는 증권사를 먼저 선택해 주세요.');
      } else {
        S.bank=pendingBank; bankError(''); renderAccount(); show('recipient-details');
      }
    } else if(a==='account-next'){
      if(validate()){
        renderRecipient('amt',S); renderAmount(); show('amount');
      }
    } else if(a==='num'){
      setAmount(Number(String(S.amount)+el.dataset.v));
    } else if(a==='del'){
      setAmount(Math.floor(S.amount/10));
    } else if(a==='quick'){
      setAmount(el.dataset.v === 'all' ? BALANCE : S.amount+Number(el.dataset.v));
    } else if(a==='amount-next'){
      if(!S.amount){
        text('amt-error','보낼 금액을 1원 이상 입력해 주세요.');
        $('amt-input').focus();
      } else {
        renderReview(); show('review');
      }
    } else if(a==='edit-account'){
      renderAccount(); show('recipient-details');
    } else if(a==='edit-amount'){
      renderAmount(); show('amount');
    } else if(a==='send'){
      if(validate()){
        S.pw=''; renderPw(); text('pw-error',''); text('processing','');
        show('identity');
      }
    } else if(a==='pw'){
      if(S.pw.length<4){ S.pw+=el.dataset.v; text('pw-error',''); renderPw(); }
    } else if(a==='pw-del'){
      S.pw=S.pw.slice(0,-1); text('pw-error',''); renderPw();
    } else if(a==='back-review'){
      S.pw=''; renderPw(); renderReview(); show('review');
    } else if(a==='execute'){
      if(S.pw.length!==4){
        text('pw-error','비밀번호 4자리를 모두 입력해 주세요.');
      } else if(validate()){
        busy=true;
        $('transfer').disabled=true;
        text('processing','모의 본인 확인 후 이체를 처리하고 있습니다.');
        transaction=Object.freeze({bank:S.bank,account:S.account,amount:S.amount,name:RECIPIENT_NAME,fee:0});
        /* 서버가 없는 시제품의 모의 처리다.
           실제 서비스는 인증 및 이체 성공 응답을 받은 뒤에만 완료로 이동해야 한다. */
        timer=setTimeout(function(){
          renderRecipient('dn',transaction);
          text('dn-amt',fmt(transaction.amount));
          S.pw=''; renderPw();
          completed=true; busy=false;
          record('transfer_complete',{amount:transaction.amount});
          show('complete');
        },350);
      }
    } else if(a==='finish'){
      record('task_end'); show('start');
    }
  });
  renderAccount(); renderAmount(); renderPw(); filterBanks();
  record('screen_enter',{to:'start'});
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
```
